detached_structure.evidence: A small light-colored rectangular object near the rear of the lot at the edge of the tree canopy may be a small shed, but it is partly obscured.

signals.notes: Gray-shingled house with multiple roof planes sits in a long narrow lot; dense mature trees cover the front and rear yards, and a gravel or dirt driveway runs along the left side, with a patio area and outdoor furniture behind the house.
